hard_simon_fitting.origin: new stdlib integer-bitparallel TRAIN consistency search over the existing clean public SIMON cone; no archived solver, runner or checkpoint imported
hard_simon_fitting.inputs: plaintext integers, TRAIN target bits, public rounds/target_bit, cooperative budget
hard_simon_fitting.key_access: no actual key, key_seed, round-key values or intermediate-state supervision; learned hard constants are permitted unknown parameters
hard_simon_fitting.model: HardSimonPredictor in models/structured_simon.py, frozen +/-1 state with exact hard Boolean forward
hard_simon_fitting.selection: first ascending integer assignment with zero TRAIN errors, not best TEST or DEV; TEST generated only after strict reload
hard_simon_fitting.scope: single output bit and single fixed key; prediction does not establish actual or unique key recovery
hard_simon_fitting.parameterization: independent symbolic round effects, current CPU enumeration limited to <=24 coordinates and configured rounds1..4
